Public AI governance guidance supports deployment when risks are measured, monitored, and documented, and model-card guidance supports disclosing intended uses, limitations, biases, ethical considerations, and evaluation results. The admissible record also shows a remaining Spanish-language billing-support weakness concentrated in billing-ticket triage, plus a draft runbook for monitoring and rollback that is not yet fully approved. Under the release policy, that unresolved slice cannot be treated as removed by the draft mitigation alone, so the defensible certification posture is certification with explicit model-card disclosure of the limitation and ongoing monitoring, not certification on a theory that no material limitation exists.
